posts.title: A Feature Flag Is Not an Authorization Check
posts.summary: Use flags to control rollout and product exposure, but authorize the requested action at the service boundary on every request. A hidden button, targeted flag, or disabled client route is not a permission check.

posts.title: A Feature Flag Does Not Undo an Irrevocable Change
posts.summary: Use flags to limit exposure, but design a compensating action for every irreversible side effect. A toggle is not a rollback plan.
